MarketCore — the UI, designed

Two surfaces, one system. The seller console — a dark 252px rail with grouped nav, a breadcrumb top bar with ⌘K search, KPI cards, charts and dense tables with share bars and status pills. And the buyer storefront — a public chrome with no rail and no tenant, because a buyer belongs to no organization and buys from any seller. Same tokens and components in both; the rail is what a tenant has and a buyer does not. Direction: Quartz, with Graphite as the dark theme. Content is the real seed data. An accessibility pass holds every text pair to 4.5:1 in both themes, gives every control a visible focus ring and an accessible name, hides decorative icons, marks the mocks inert so the board is not a tab trap, and treats motion as a preference.
